items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: But after he was killed and President Johnson came in, and they had to change the style, because there was a different personality in the White House.

ctx.x: And they could write funnier things, personal things, you know. But after he was killed and President Johnson came in, and they had to change the style, because there was a different personality in the White House. And it wasn't just about the White House itself, but it was just about current events in general.
